gate: DP1 Gate A / D38 — no file in web/ or cli/ changes while L4 is completed.
enumeration: every path under src/shepherd/web/ and src/shepherd/cli/ from rglob('*') that is_file() and whose parts contain no __pycache__, as {posix path relative to src/shepherd: sha256 hex}. Enumerated, never hand-listed (K19).
ordering_claim: UNVERIFIABLE IN THIS TREE. That this manifest was frozen BEFORE the registry work is transcript evidence only: `git log -- docs/plans/` is empty, everything is untracked on one baseline commit, and no ordering of edits is recoverable. A VCS baseline would fix it outright and is rejected on a standing instruction, not on merit (plan, Open decisions). M3 clause 16 is the precedent.
rebase_rule: `baseline` is the step-0b freeze and is NEVER rewritten. `files` is what Gate A compares the live tree against. T24 is the ONLY task permitted to re-base, exactly once: it updates `files`, sets rebase.regenerated_by to "T24" and lists every path it moved in rebase.regenerated_paths. test_a_rebase_declares_every_path_whose_digest_moved asserts moved_paths(baseline, files) == set(regenerated_paths), so a re-base that quietly absorbs an unrelated change is caught rather than blessed.

rebase.why: DP1: the chat page is a file in web/, so Gate A is re-based exactly once rather than deleted. baseline is untouched, so moved_paths(baseline, files) is still computable and must equal regenerated_paths (test_a_rebase_declares_every_path_whose_digest_moved).

post_milestone.rule: Edits made AFTER M4 closed, which D38 does not govern. D38's sentence is "if M4 changes a file in web/ or cli/, the placeholder had the wrong shape" — it is a claim about completing L4, and that milestone is closed and verified. This block is NOT a second re-base: `rebase` stays T24's, spent exactly once, and `baseline` is still never rewritten. Every entry names a path, a date, an agent and a reason; the paths here must be DISJOINT from rebase.regenerated_paths, so this block can never be used to relaunder a path T24 already moved; and moved_paths(baseline, files) must equal regenerated_paths + these paths exactly, so an unrelated change still cannot ride along in silence.

edits.why: **Changed twice.** D6: the emulator was constructed with no `cols` and no `rows`, so it drew at xterm's default 80x24 at every viewport from 390 to 2560 for a 160x45 pane, inside a container that is `overflow: hidden` on both axes — 366px of pane unreachable at 390, and a rendered right edge of 1517 in a 1440 window. It is now fitted to its container at open and on every resize, and the one residual the fit cannot close (the pane keeps its own geometry, so a window narrower than it re-wraps) is declared on the page beside T19-c's sentence. Measured in a real browser by `tests/web/test_terminal_fit_live.py`. Then changed by the qa6 bugfix plan (2026-09-24), BC-10 (plan P15): the first frame, the pane snapshot, was written as captured — text rows followed by the pane's trailing blank lines — so an emulator with fewer rows than the pane scrolled the text out and opened on blank rows. Frame 1 now goes through the new pure export `snapshotForEmulator(capture)`, which trims the trailing run of LF/CR/space and ends a non-empty snapshot with one CR LF so the next live chunk starts at column 0; live chunks (frames 2+) are unchanged. Proved in a real browser by tests/web/test_terminal_sse_qa6_live.py::test_the_snapshot_text_is_visible_on_open. Ledger: docs/plans/qa6-bugfix-blockers/P15.md.
